name: Face Stealer, Major (Su)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents, minor face stealer talent, moderate face stealer talent

Benefit(s): The slayer’s face stealer ability talent can act as polymorph (self only) rather than disguise self.
